t: You're looking at the Middlesex Guildhall, on the south-western corner of Parliament Square, close to the Palace of Westminster. It's a historic court building, and it now houses the Supreme Court of the United Kingdom and the Judicial Committee of the Privy Council. It was listed Grade II* in 1970. The architect who designed it was James Glen Sivewright Gibson, a British architect working in the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries. So the building you see is his work.
